name: Sonya Hartlova
source:
Daughter of Ekaterina and twin sister of Alex. She is an Art and Biology teacher, who is currently unemployed. She announces her pregnancy at the start of the game, though the father of the baby is unknown.

[spoiler]Gave her virginity to Alex, who is also the father of her current child. She is a child Ekaterina had with her father.[/spoiler]
